description: This file is a shell script designed to test the output of 'git push' in porcelain mode under various conditions, including success, failure, forced updates, atomic pushes, and dry runs. It sets up repositories, performs push operations, and verifies the output against expected results, primarily focusing on distinguishing the output formats and behaviors specific to 'git push --porcelain'.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates commits in a given repository and assigns commit hashes to provided variable names.

methods.name: get_abbrev_oid
methods.description: Produces an abbreviated object ID from a full SHA1, used for simplification in output comparison.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Formats git command outputs into a standardized, human-readable, and stable format for testing verification.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Prepares expected output for comparison by formatting and saving it into a file.

methods.name: create_upstream_template
methods.description: Initializes a bare upstream repository, creates commits, and pushes certain refs for testing.

methods.name: setup_upstream
methods.description: Clones or mirrors a upstream repository, configuring it for testing, with optional protocol-specific setup.

methods.name: setup_upstream_and_workbench
methods.description: Sets up upstream and local working repositories for testing push scenarios, including branch ref updates.

methods.name: run_git_push_porcelain_output_test
methods.description: Executes a series of 'git push --porcelain' tests, verifying output formats, behavior on rejection, forced updates, atomic pushes, and hooks.

methods.name: run_git_push_dry_run_porcelain_output_test
methods.description: Performs 'git push --porcelain --dry-run' tests to check output consistency and rejection scenarios.
